label: A Different Kind of Valentine: B

lines.text: Every Valentine's Day, various events take place around the Ark.
In particular, Maid Cafes tend to host a diverse range of events.
This year, a special event is being held at one of the branches.
You want me to oversee one of the Maid Cafe branches?

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: You're the only one we could think of to ask.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Everything is already prepared. All you need to do is supervise during business hours.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You already know how a Maid Cafe operates,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: since you're here all the time.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Yeah! You know us better than anyone.
While walking, lost in thought, I eventually arrive at the building Ade told me about.
I walk towards the entrance that is decorated in a typical style fitting that of a Maid Cafe.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Sorry, but we're not open y... *Gasp*!

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Wait, are you the new manager?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: I heard they'd be sending over a temporary manager, but I didn't know it was you!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: This is great. It's always better to work with someone you know.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ※▣Come now, why such a muted greeting? Especially considering how long▣□it's been since we last saw※each other.
I don't know you'd be here.
I was caught off guard by your outfit, that's all.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □▣※Thanks to you, I was rehabilitated,□※▣and I've been looking for□□something to amuse myself with.□▣※

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣※That's when I heard※▣they were hiring maids here.▣※
Is that supposed to be a maid outfit?
Taking my eyes off Sin, I glance at the two other Nikkes.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: What do you think of our maid outfits?
Those are supposed to be maid outfits?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: You've got a weird look on your face.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣※※Apparently, they're going with a different theme▣for this particular branch.※▣

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: We're supposed to wear outfits which spark the customer's romantic imagination.
I scrutinize Mast's outfit more closely.
Are you supposed to be a pirate?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: I knew you'd get it straight away!
Mast takes a few steps back and strikes a pose.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Long boots that spark the imagination!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Letting my hair down, when it's usually tied up!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: What do you think? Isn't this the stuff of your dreams?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: It's not just that I'm a pirate maid,

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: it's that every element of my getup is infused with a sense of romance.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣□※I have to admit, I□□※ think it's pretty good.▣

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣▣□There's a reason※why you won 1st place in the audition.▣□

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: They held an audition, and only those who passed could work here.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: The main criterion was to see how well you embodied the theme of romance.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: So it stands to reason that I'd take top place.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I only got in this outfit because Mast tricked me, and said we were heading out to sea.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: The judge thought I was cute, so she let me through.
She's risen pretty far for a maid.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Anyway, now that you're here to help run the place,

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: I suppose I should be calling you Manager instead of Captain.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □□Would you like to※□▣take a look around the cafe first, Master?▣※※

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □※▣So that's what※▣□you were getting at.□※▣I was wondering.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: Not at all. It's just a title.□※▣

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Right. And we are maids now, after all.
Could... you call me that one more time?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Captain, why are you making that expression?!
Especially when it makes the Master himself a bit embarrassed.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣※▣□If we're going to□▣talk about being embarrassed,□aren't these outfits※▣of ours more egregious?□

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: This outfit is a perfect fusion of a pirate and maid.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: It's the epitome of romance, and a masterpiece for the ages!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: If wearing this made me self-conscious, I couldn't call myself a pirate.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Now then... I can't let something like this get the best of me...

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: *Sigh*... Could you let me get away with that?
It's very Mast-like. I'm into it.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: You don't have to lie to make me feel better, Master Captain!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Do you think I'm gonna give you some special treatment if you flatter me? Pssh.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: ... Anyway, have a seat. I've got to handle some finishing touches before we open.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ※▣□How pure and□□innocent she is.※▣In fact, I'm sure□she'd believe※▣whatever I told her...

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣※□□I promise※▣I won't get up※□□to any funny business.▣

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ... □□※At least not※while I'm working at this cafe.※▣

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣▣I'm telling you, I don't※▣have any ulterior motives!

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □□□I simply※▣thought this looked fun,※※▣so I signed up.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣▣Why would I※▣ruin an interesting opportunity like this?※□□

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □▣Plus, ▣I'll have you along for the ride,□□so what's there▣▣to worry about?※▣

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ※※▣Also, I'm still wearing the▣▣converter, see? I simply changed to one□▣※that's more comfortable.▣□□

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □※I expected it'd take at least□▣two days of convincing to sway you.□※
Turning away from Sin's unnervingly large grin, I look around the modestly sized dining area.
Are you three the only ones here?
I look in the direction that Sin is pointing.
Sin gestures towards a shadowy corner of the dining area.
Cloistered tightly in the corner, is the fourth maid.
